This file freezes the currently visible source-level contract per published artifact using the [Public API Boundaries](public-api-boundaries.md). Packages containing `domain`, `port`, `api`, or descendants of those segments are supported by convention. `adapter`, `autoconfigure`, `serialization`, `internal`, and build logic are implementation by default. Documented package and type exceptions are consumer API. Infrastructure types are public for framework wiring. Public internal types require review and are not supported extension points.
